summary.en: Iraqi courts sentenced seven French citizens to lengthy prison terms for Islamic State membership, including six life sentences, while security forces downed an unidentified drone over Baghdad with air defenses. Yazidi militia units linked to the PKK are disarming and joining the Iraqi army, and other militia groups have pledged to disarm by mid‑2027. The prime minister visited Damascus, dismissed four officers for allowing the PMF to desecrate a US flag, and announced a reshuffle of more than 50 posts amid disputes over Sinjar security and YBS integration under federal authority. The conflict produced 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske domstoler dømte syv franske borgere til lange fengselsstraffer for medlemskap i IS, inkludert seks livstidsdommer, mens sikkerhetsstyrker skjøt ned en ukjent drone over Bagdad med luftforsvar. Yazidi-militære enheter knyttet til PKK blir avrustet og slutter seg til den irakiske hæren, og andre militsgrupper har lovet å avrustes innen midten av 2027. Statsministeren besøkte Damaskus, avskjedigede fire offiserer for å ha tillatt PMF å vanhellige et amerikansk flagg, og kunngjorde en omorganisering av mer enn 50 stillinger midt i tvister om sikkerheten i Sinjar og YBS-integrering under føderal myndighet. Konflikten førte til 396 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
